```{=html}
<style>
.w012 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w012 .w012-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w012 .w012-buckets { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w012 .w012-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 220px; min-height: 150px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w012 .w012-bucket.w012-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w012 .w012-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.w012 .w012-bdesc { text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w012 .w012-drop { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; }
.w012 .w012-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600;
}
.w012 .w012-chip.w012-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w012 .w012-chip.w012-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w012 .w012-chip.w012-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w012 .w012-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w012 button.w012-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w012 .w012-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w012 .w012-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w012 .w012-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w012 .w012-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w012 iw" id="w012">
  <div class="w012-pool" aria-label="stack layers to classify"></div>
  <div class="w012-buckets">
    <div class="w012-bucket" data-cat="c">
      <div class="w012-btitle">Customer secures</div>
      <div class="w012-bdesc">the customer's responsibility<br>in IaaS</div>
      <div class="w012-drop"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w012-bucket" data-cat="p">
      <div class="w012-btitle">Provider secures</div>
      <div class="w012-bdesc">the provider's responsibility<br>in IaaS</div>
      <div class="w012-drop"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w012-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w012-btn w012-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w012-btn w012-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w012-btn w012-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w012-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w012-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w012');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w012-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w012-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w012-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['Operating system', 'c'],
    ['Networking', 'p'],
    ['Data', 'c'],
    ['Virtualisation', 'p'],
    ['Application', 'c'],
    ['Servers & storage', 'p'],
    ['Runtime & middleware', 'c']
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w012-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w012-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w012-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w012-right', 'w012-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w012-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w012-drop').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(label, cat, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w012-chip';
    c.textContent = label;
    c.dataset.cat = cat;
    c.dataset.id = 'w012i' + i;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w012-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w012-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.id));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w012-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w012-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w012-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, unplaced = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w012-chip').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w012-right', 'w012-wrong');
      if (c.parentElement === pool) { unplaced++; return; }
      const bucket = c.closest('.w012-bucket');
      if (c.dataset.cat === bucket.dataset.cat) { c.classList.add('w012-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w012-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — responsibility follows control of each layer.'; msg.className = 'w012-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unplaced > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unplaced + ' layer(s) still unplaced.'; msg.className = 'w012-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red layers sit on the wrong side of the split.'; msg.className = 'w012-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w012-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w012-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w012-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w012-chip').forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      bucket.querySelector('.w012-drop').appendChild(c);
      c.classList.add('w012-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w012-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it[0], it[1], i)));
})();
</script>
```
